query: In which cases does the Cyber Crime Wing of Tamil Nadu Police engage?
reference_answer:
Cyber Crime Wing Cases:
The Cyber Crime Wing of Tamil Nadu Police handles cases related to online crimes, including hacking, phishing, online harassment, and cyber frauds.
answer: The Cyber Crime Wing of Tamil Nadu Police engages in cases involving cybercrime, such as hacking, online fraud, and child exploitation. [Document 1]
